name: Dealcrest
summary: A six-page sales CRM starter with an editable pipeline, split-flap numbers and a what-if forecast
about: A front-end sales CRM for teams that want a working pipeline to build on. Deals move across a drag-and-drop board while a live forecast shows what each drop would change, and the stages themselves are edited in Settings. Contacts, tasks, reports and a live activity feed come with sample data in US dollars.
how: Use the tabs at the top (a bottom bar on phones) to switch between the six pages.
On Dashboard, switch 7D, 30D or 12M and watch the split-flap numbers flip and the revenue chart morph.
On Pipeline, drag a deal: the forecast bar shows what the total becomes before you drop it. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip button.
Filter the board by text or owner, sort cards, or add a deal straight into a stage.
Open a deal to change its stage, add notes, edit or delete it with undo.
Add tasks with the quick bar, filter them by day and tick them off.
In Settings, rename, recolour, reorder, add or remove pipeline stages and team members, export the data as JSON or reset the demo.
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, deal or contact.
